fixture_boundary: These are review-case specifications, not submissions or scientific data. Any executable synthetic fixture is confined to temporary work/test_runs directories.

positive_cases.expected: Eligible for criterion-specific credit if the actual evidence supports the stated scope; no automatic pass.
positive_cases.route: A justified structural/contact analysis can answer geometric packing questions without a forced dimer-energy matrix; its causal/energetic conclusions remain limited.

positive_cases.expected: Same scientific standard as supported author conclusion; uncertainty must follow substantive evidence.

negative_cases.enforcement: Real artifact/semantic review is required; not proved by schema tests.
